_source: L12 (work plan 2). 5e healing tiers and potion effects, named in Bellmire's plain voice; brewed at the apothecary (!brew <key>), found below on a good search. 'tier' = the town tier the apothecary needs (Roster.town_tier).

mending.name: Draught of Mending
mending.flavour: Red, thin, and it tastes of iron. It works.

greater.name: Greater Mending
greater.flavour: Brewed twice and stoppered with wax.

superior.name: Superior Mending
superior.flavour: The apothecary will not say what is in it.

supreme.name: Supreme Mending
supreme.flavour: A guild price for a guild life.

antidote.name: Bitterleaf Tincture
antidote.flavour: Ends a venom. Ruins a supper.

emberward.name: Emberward
emberward.flavour: Drunk cold. You will want it cold.

hearthwarm.name: Hearthwarm
hearthwarm.flavour: Spiced, and warm all the way down.

quickwater.name: Quickwater
quickwater.flavour: The drinker hears their own heart outrun them.

ogre.name: Ogre's Draught
ogre.flavour: Thick as porridge, and it hits like a door.

shadow.name: Shadowcloak
shadow.flavour: The dark forgets you, until you strike.

bravecup.name: Bravecup
bravecup.flavour: Mead and something stronger than mead.

owl.name: Owl-eye Drops
owl.flavour: Two drops in each eye, and the dark goes grey.

fieldmend.name: Field Dressing
fieldmend.flavour: A rag, a splash of spirits, and no time to be gentle.

stillblood.name: Stillblood Tincture
stillblood.flavour: Thicker than bitterleaf, and it stays down.

clearsight.name: Clearsight Drops
clearsight.flavour: Stings like the truth. Then you can see again.

nightdraught.name: Nightdraught
nightdraught.flavour: The apothecary's own, for the long watch.

wardwater.name: Wardwater
wardwater.flavour: A skinful, blessed at the chapel font.

knitbone.name: Knitbone Brew
knitbone.flavour: Green, and it moves a little in the bottle.

deepdraught.name: Deepdraught
deepdraught.flavour: Brewed for the long descents. Tastes of cold stone and keeps you going.

wyrmsbane.name: Wyrmsbane
wyrmsbane.flavour: Bitter as a dragon's regard. Drink it before the breath, not after.

mirewine.name: Mirewine
mirewine.flavour: Bellmire's own. Braver by the bottle, foolish by the jug.

lastlight.name: Lastlight
lastlight.flavour: Lit against the dark at the bottom of everything.

kingsmend.name: The Hollow King's Cup
kingsmend.flavour: Poured once for a king who would not heal. It heals you instead.

scarwater.name: Scarwater
scarwater.flavour: Drawn from the scar itself. It cuts both ways, and it knows which.

pennymend.name: Pennymend
pennymend.flavour: A copper's worth of mending. Better than nothing, and it knows it.

ratnip.name: Ratcatcher's Nip
ratnip.flavour: He drinks it himself, which is the only recommendation it needs.

thawbottle.name: Thawbottle
thawbottle.flavour: Corked in the cold snap and kept for the next one.

longwatch.name: Longwatch Drops
longwatch.flavour: Two drops and a whole night. The walls are walked on these.

commanders_flask.name: The Commander's Flask
commanders_flask.flavour: E3PO carries one and has never opened it. That is the point of it.

mirestep.name: Mirestep
mirestep.flavour: The mire lets go of your boots. Everything else still has hold of you.

quarryblood.name: Quarryblood
quarryblood.flavour: What the masons drink on the day a wall has to go up.

gravewater.name: Gravewater
gravewater.flavour: Drawn from the chapel well, behind the stones. It holds the first blow.

deepstill.name: Deepstill
deepstill.flavour: Brewed thick for the floors where help is a very long way up.

bellwater.name: Bellwater
bellwater.flavour: Blessed under a bell with no clapper. It rings anyway, and so does this.

sweetwater.name: Sweetwater
sweetwater.flavour: Bellmire's own well, boiled with honey. Mends a little and lifts a lot.

cloisterbrew.name: Cloisterbrew
cloisterbrew.flavour: The chapel brews it for the watch and charges the guild double.

doorkeep.name: Doorkeeper's Draught
doorkeep.flavour: Drunk on the threshold. Keep the door, and the door keeps you.

foxfire.name: Foxfire Drops
foxfire.flavour: Cold green light behind the eyes, and the dark turns shallow.

grainmeasure.name: The Grain Measure
grainmeasure.flavour: Four doses to a flask, and the apothecary counts them out loud.

hushwine.name: Hushwine
hushwine.flavour: Nobody remembers the drinker. The drinker included.

fellstill.name: Fellstill
fellstill.flavour: Two ills in one bottle, and it tastes of both.

lampwater.name: Lampwater
lampwater.flavour: Thin and oily, and the dark goes one lamp wider.

quarrymend.name: Quarrymend
quarrymend.flavour: Grit in the bottom of the flask. Drink that too.

fenward.name: Fenward
fenward.flavour: Boiled out of the worst water in Bellmire. It knows poison personally.

criers_cup.name: The Crier's Cup
criers_cup.flavour: One swallow and the whole room can hear you.

stonewater.name: Stonewater
stonewater.flavour: Settles in the chest like a kept wall.

hostsilence.name: Host's Silence
hostsilence.flavour: The rattle stops. So does everything else about you.

coldcount.name: Coldcount
coldcount.flavour: Mourncoil taught the apothecary this one, unwillingly.

wallmend.name: Wallmend
wallmend.flavour: Masons' brew. It does for a man what mortar does for a course.

tollwater.name: Tollwater
tollwater.flavour: Paid in advance. The road goes past quicker.

clearfen.name: Clearfen Drops
clearfen.flavour: Stings worse than whatever blinded you. Works faster, too.

ferrywater.name: Ferryman's Measure
ferrywater.flavour: Drunk at the crossing. Paid for on the far bank.

brightbone.name: Brightbone
brightbone.flavour: Knits what the Ossuary Lord undid. Tastes of chalk and says so.

emberdregs.name: Ember Dregs
emberdregs.flavour: The bottom of the emberward jar, sold cheap. Still puts you out.

rushlight.name: Rushlight Draught
rushlight.flavour: Cheaper than a lamp, and nothing down there sees you carrying it.

mustering_cup.name: Mustering Cup
mustering_cup.flavour: Poured at the barracks door. Nobody drinks it sitting down.

quietwater.name: Quietwater
quietwater.flavour: Bellmire's oldest answer to a bad decision.

oxdraught.name: Ox-Draught
oxdraught.flavour: Drovers' brew. Doubles the man, and the appetite with him.

mirethistle.name: Mirethistle Tincture
mirethistle.flavour: Bitter as the fen it came out of. Swallow it, do not sip it.

watchmans_pint.name: Watchman's Pint
watchmans_pint.flavour: Slow and steady, like the man they named it after.

millrace.name: Millrace
millrace.flavour: Goes through you the way the river goes under the wheel.

chapelwater.name: Chapel Water
chapelwater.flavour: Blessed on a feast day. Works on the other days as well.

scarbite.name: Scarbite
scarbite.flavour: The scar in a bottle. The apothecary charges extra for the stopper.

gatewater.name: Gatewater
gatewater.flavour: Drawn from the butt by the town gate. The guard swears by it; the guard is also never hurt.

chalkdraught.name: Chalk Draught
chalkdraught.flavour: White, gritty, and it clears the eyes of whatever the scar put there.

tallow_cup.name: Tallow Cup
tallow_cup.flavour: Cheap, foul, and it saves a lamp's worth of oil every time.

guildmend.name: Guild Mending
guildmend.flavour: The guild's own, bought at the guild's own price. Nobody pretends otherwise.

bannerbrew.name: Banner Brew
bannerbrew.flavour: Served before the colours go up. Half of it is the colours.

fordwater.name: Ford Water
fordwater.flavour: Cold enough that nothing colder impresses you afterwards.

smithsdram.name: Smith's Dram
smithsdram.flavour: One mouthful, one lift. The smith measures it herself.

keepwater.name: Keepwater
keepwater.flavour: Keep the door. Keep the drinker. In that order, the apothecary says.

longmend.name: Long Mending
longmend.flavour: Works slowly and completely, which is the wrong way round for most nights down there.

scarquiet.name: Scarquiet
scarquiet.flavour: The scar stops arguing for a minute. Only a minute.

lordsmeasure.name: Lord's Measure
lordsmeasure.flavour: Brewed for the night a lord rises. Priced for the same night.

deeplast.name: Deep Last
deeplast.flavour: The bottle you do not open unless you have already decided to come back up.

orchardwater.name: Orchard Water
orchardwater.flavour: Pressed, not brewed. The apothecary calls it a tonic; the orchard calls it cider.

netmenders_dram.name: Netmender's Dram
netmenders_dram.flavour: Drunk to keep the fingers quick. It keeps the rest of you quick as well.

collierbrew.name: Collier's Brew
collierbrew.flavour: The charcoal-burners drink it standing in the smoke. They are never the ones who come out burnt.

haywards_cup.name: Hayward's Cup
haywards_cup.flavour: He walks the hedges after dark and has never once carried a lamp.

reeves_measure.name: The Reeve's Measure
reeves_measure.flavour: Measured to the drop and written in the ledger. Everything the reeve touches is.

winterwatch.name: Winterwatch
winterwatch.flavour: Brewed in the thaw for the next frost. The town has learned to think a season ahead.

shepherds_flask.name: Shepherd's Flask
shepherds_flask.flavour: A night on the high ground with wolves below teaches a man what to put in a flask.

sawyers_dram.name: Sawyer's Dram
sawyers_dram.flavour: Two strokes to the cut instead of three. Taken at the pit, never at the tavern.

wellhead_draught.name: Wellhead Draught
wellhead_draught.flavour: Drawn from the deep well, where the water has never seen the scar.

chandlers_light.name: Chandler's Light
chandlers_light.flavour: She sells the candles too. She will tell you honestly which of the two lasts longer.

kennelwater.name: Kennel Water
kennelwater.flavour: What the houndmaster gives a dog before a bad night. It does not ask whether you are a dog.

threshers_pint.name: Thresher's Pint
threshers_pint.flavour: A full day on the floor with a flail, in one swallow. Drink it sitting down.

hedgeward.name: Hedgeward
hedgeward.flavour: Green, bitter, and full of the thorns it was meant to protect you from.

ostlers_bottle.name: Ostler's Bottle
ostlers_bottle.flavour: He keeps it for the horses. He keeps a second one for himself and admits nothing.

saltboilers_last.name: The Saltboiler's Last
saltboilers_last.flavour: Boiled down from a week of brine to a single cup. It costs him the week.

wheelwrights_turn.name: The Wheelwright's Turn
wheelwrights_turn.flavour: One turn of the wheel, and the scar decides which way. He has stopped drinking it himself.

bakers_pennyworth.name: The Baker's Pennyworth
bakers_pennyworth.flavour: A penny, a heel of bread and whatever he had steeping. It is honest about what it is.

tinkers_phial.name: Tinker's Phial
tinkers_phial.flavour: He sells three things and mends four. This is the one he will not explain.

almshouse_broth.name: Almshouse Broth
almshouse_broth.flavour: Thin, hot and given away free to those who need it. You are paying because you do not.

alewifes_short.name: The Alewife's Short Measure
alewifes_short.flavour: She pours it short and dares you to say so. Nobody ever has.

coopers_measure.name: The Cooper's Measure
coopers_measure.flavour: Exactly a cup. He made the cup, so he would know.

ropewalk_dram.name: Ropewalk Dram
ropewalk_dram.flavour: Drunk at the far end of the walk, where the rope is longest and the day is not.

miners_draught.name: Miner's Draught
miners_draught.flavour: They go down further than you and they go down without a lamp. Ask them why.

shinglers_dram.name: Shingler's Dram
shinglers_dram.flavour: For a man on a cold roof in a wind. It does not warm you; it stops the cold mattering.

potters_glaze.name: Potter's Glaze
potters_glaze.flavour: What she paints on a pot before the kiln. Drink it and you are the pot.

tanners_bitters.name: Tanner's Bitters
tanners_bitters.flavour: He works all day in worse than this. It tastes of the yard and it works.

carters_flask.name: The Carter's Flask
carters_flask.flavour: Four more miles before dark, every time, for years. The flask is older than the cart.

dyers_vat.name: Dyer's Vat
dyers_vat.flavour: A swallow of the vat and the colour takes you instead of the cloth. Briefly.

plasterers_cup.name: Plasterer's Cup
plasterers_cup.flavour: A skin over everything, thin and set hard. He says the trick is the first coat.

glaziers_light.name: Glazier's Light
glaziers_light.flavour: He has spent his life looking through things. He bottled the habit.

masons_water.name: Mason's Water
masons_water.flavour: Off the stone and tasting of it. Sets what was loose.

fletchers_dram.name: Fletcher's Dram
fletchers_dram.flavour: Straight, fast and finished in a hurry - the same three things he asks of an arrow.

weavers_thread.name: The Weaver's Thread
weavers_thread.flavour: Pulled through you a little at a time, closing as it goes. She will not be rushed and nor will it.

drillyard_pint.name: The Drill Yard Pint
drillyard_pint.flavour: Poured at the yard after a hard morning. The Commander allows one.

limeburners_cup.name: The Limeburner's Cup
limeburners_cup.flavour: He stands beside the kiln all week and comes home unburnt. This is the whole of his secret.

bellfounders_pour.name: The Bellfounder's Pour
bellfounders_pour.flavour: Poured the way he pours bronze - once, hot, and all of it. There is no second pour.

thatchers_cup.name: The Thatcher's Cup
thatchers_cup.flavour: Reed-sweet and sticky. It knits a scraped shin and little else.

coracle_dram.name: The Coracle Dram
coracle_dram.flavour: Fordmen drink it mid-river. It stays down, which is the point.

brewers_bracing.name: The Brewer's Bracing
brewers_bracing.flavour: Drunk before the fight and not after. Mostly.

smokehouse_tonic.name: The Smokehouse Tonic
smokehouse_tonic.flavour: Tastes of ham. Nobody asks why it works.

cartwrights_linchpin.name: The Cartwright's Linchpin
cartwrights_linchpin.flavour: Holds the whole wheel together. Holds you, for a bit.

stonecutters_pour.name: The Stonecutter's Pour
stonecutters_pour.flavour: Grey, gritty, and it settles in the bones like mortar.

lamplighters_measure.name: The Lamplighter's Measure
lamplighters_measure.flavour: One measure for each lamp on the lane. He never skips one.

wallwrights_mortar.name: The Wallwright's Last Mortar
wallwrights_mortar.flavour: Poured into the last gap in the wall. Pour it into yours.

chapterhouse_cordial.name: The Chapterhouse Cordial
chapterhouse_cordial.flavour: Brewed by monks who swear they only brew for the sick. The sick are many.

quarrymans_nerve.name: The Quarryman's Nerve
quarrymans_nerve.flavour: Drunk at the lip of the cut. It steadies the knees and the pride.

millwrights_haste.name: The Millwright's Haste
millwrights_haste.flavour: Races the wheel, and wins. Briefly.

candlemakers_sight.name: The Candlemaker's Sight
candlemakers_sight.flavour: Wick-thin light behind the eyes. The dark lets go of its edges.

fullers_ward.name: The Fuller's Ward
fullers_ward.flavour: Pounded thick and shrunk tight. Whatever hits you finds it felted.

gravediggers_hush.name: The Gravedigger's Hush
gravediggers_hush.flavour: He has stood beside the living without being seen for years. It is not a gift.

hospitallers_drip.name: The Hospitaller's Drip
hospitallers_drip.flavour: One drop at a time, for a long time. The patient is not to hurry.

stevedores_heft.name: The Stevedore's Heft
stevedores_heft.flavour: Three barrels at once. His back remembers; yours will not.

wintercarters_dram.name: The Wintercarter's Dram
wintercarters_dram.flavour: Hauls ice from the pond to the cellar and never feels it.

chandlers_cooling.name: The Chandler's Cooling
chandlers_cooling.flavour: Cold tallow on a hot hand. He has needed it often.

scarlots_draw.name: The Scarlot's Draw
scarlots_draw.flavour: Drawn from the scar by a stranger. The Scar picks the winner.

woundwort_water.name: Woundwort Water
woundwort_water.flavour: Green, bitter, and it draws a venom out of a bite.

lampsmoke_clearwater.name: Lamp-Smoke Clearwater
lampsmoke_clearwater.flavour: A wash for stinging eyes. It runs black first, then clear.

drovers_brace.name: The Drover's Brace
drovers_brace.flavour: Taken before the herd goes through the narrows. Takes the shake out.

hearthstone_loosener.name: The Hearthstone Loosener
hearthstone_loosener.flavour: Warm stone in a cup. The legs remember they are legs.

snuffers_salve.name: The Snuffer's Salve-Water
snuffers_salve.flavour: For the hand that put out one flame too late.

wickmenders_sip.name: The Wickmender's Sip
wickmenders_sip.flavour: For the lamplighter's burnt thumb and the long walk home.

bargemans_draught.name: Bargeman's Draught
bargemans_draught.flavour: Hot, sweet and thick as river-mud. The legs stop sulking.

pitchwater.name: Pitchwater
pitchwater.flavour: Dark, bitter and cold as a well. The flame forgets itself.

dewcap_drops.name: Dewcap Drops
dewcap_drops.flavour: Morning dew from the old orchard. Rinse the eyes, not the mouth.

ferrymans_nip.name: The Ferryman's Nip
ferrymans_nip.flavour: Half a swallow before the ford. The oar moves faster than the arm.

saltwatch.name: Saltwatch Drops
saltwatch.flavour: Brine in the eye stings once. After that the dark has edges.

gaolers_calm.name: The Gaoler's Calm
gaolers_calm.flavour: Kept for the man who walks the cells at night. Keys do not rattle.

hearthkeepers_pour.name: Hearthkeeper's Pour
hearthkeepers_pour.flavour: Poured last, from the pot that never goes cold.

bellringers_breath.name: The Bellringer's Breath
bellringers_breath.flavour: Held in the chest through the long toll. Blows ring off you instead.

crowfeather_draught.name: Crowfeather Draught
crowfeather_draught.flavour: Black, bitter, and the room forgets you are in it.

stillwater_deep.name: Stillwater Deep
stillwater_deep.flavour: From the well under the chapel. It does not ripple, and neither will you.

shieldwrights_dram.name: The Shieldwright's Dram
shieldwrights_dram.flavour: Oak, iron and a little spite. Your arm remembers being a door.

wyrmwake_cup.name: Wyrmwake Cup
wyrmwake_cup.flavour: Brewed from the ash a Gravewyrm leaves. It owes you the cold.

founders_measure.name: The Founder's Measure
founders_measure.flavour: Bottled when the first stone was laid. Opened only for the stones that follow.

scarsworn_vial.name: Scarsworn Vial
scarsworn_vial.flavour: Swear to the scar and it will keep one promise. Which one is its business.

kingsrest.name: King's Rest
kingsrest.flavour: Sleep, but standing. The hurt knits while the crown sits easy.

tallowsalve.name: Tallow Salve
tallowsalve.flavour: Rendered fat and honey. It smells like a mistake and works like a cure.

gleaners_cup.name: The Gleaner's Cup
gleaners_cup.flavour: Whatever the field left behind, steeped. Nobody wastes it.

hedgecutters_dram.name: Hedgecutter's Dram
hedgecutters_dram.flavour: Thornwood tonic. It kills the venom and stings the tongue.

reedcutters_brew.name: Reedcutter's Brew
reedcutters_brew.flavour: Marsh-reed and bog-water. It gets the mud out of your legs.

pennywhistle_cure.name: Pennywhistle Cure
pennywhistle_cure.flavour: Sold from a tray at the gate. It clears the eyes and the gut, in that order.

turners_oil.name: Turner's Oil
turners_oil.flavour: Lathe oil on the tongue. Everything spins faster after.

smelters_gulp.name: Smelter's Gulp
smelters_gulp.flavour: Slag-warm and bitter. The furnace stops caring about you.

icewardens_sip.name: Ice-Warden's Sip
icewardens_sip.flavour: Cold for the cold. The wind goes round you.

bellows_breath.name: Bellows-Breath
bellows_breath.flavour: Held in the lungs, let go all at once.

gatekeepers_nerve.name: The Gatekeeper's Nerve
gatekeepers_nerve.flavour: For the one who stands at the door when it is dark. It steadies the knees.

owlwings_wash.name: Owlwing Wash
owlwings_wash.flavour: Dripped in the eyes. The dark gives up its corners.

glassblowers_clear.name: Glassblower's Clear
glassblowers_clear.flavour: Clears the eyes. The smoke was never your fault, but it is your problem.

marshlight_vial.name: Marshlight Vial
marshlight_vial.flavour: Swamp-glow in a phial. The eye slides off you.

pikemans_resolve.name: The Pikeman's Resolve
pikemans_resolve.flavour: Steady feet, steady spear, steady stomach.

wardens_ward.name: Warden's Ward
wardens_ward.flavour: The old warden left the recipe and nothing else. It turns the first blow.

gravecloth_draught.name: Gravecloth Draught
gravecloth_draught.flavour: Steeped in a shroud. The dead do not look twice at you.

hillgiants_breakfast.name: The Hill-Giant's Breakfast
hillgiants_breakfast.flavour: Three eggs, a haunch and a prayer. The door should be afraid.

deepwell_mending.name: Deepwell Mending
deepwell_mending.flavour: From the bottom of the old well. It forgives the flesh, slowly.

cairn_lantern.name: Cairn Lantern
cairn_lantern.flavour: A cold light behind the eyes. The cairns are not dark any more.

bishops_mercy.name: The Bishop's Mercy
bishops_mercy.flavour: Blessed twice and cheaper than a pardon. The hurt closes at once.

stormcallers_draught.name: Stormcaller's Draught
stormcallers_draught.flavour: The thunder arrives after you do.

scarkeepers_vow.name: The Scarkeeper's Vow
scarkeepers_vow.flavour: Keep the scar and it keeps you. For one breath, at least.

kingsguard_tonic.name: Kingsguard Tonic
kingsguard_tonic.flavour: Poured for the ones who stand behind the throne and do not blink.

crownwatch_cup.name: Crownwatch Cup
crownwatch_cup.flavour: A full night on the walls in one swallow. Nothing gets past the second blow.

tilers_draught.name: Tiler's Draught
tilers_draught.flavour: Warm clay and ginger. The knees unlock.

ropers_eyewash.name: Roper's Eyewash
ropers_eyewash.flavour: Cold tea and salt. Wash it out and look again.

salters_cure.name: Salter's Cure
salters_cure.flavour: Brine and bitter root. It stings. It works.

kilnmans_brace.name: Kilnman's Brace
kilnmans_brace.flavour: Taken at the kiln mouth. The heat stands off a pace.

icehouse_ladle.name: Icehouse Ladle
icehouse_ladle.flavour: Cut from the icehouse floor. Cold stops meaning much.

reedlight_vial.name: Reedlight Vial
reedlight_vial.flavour: Rush oil under the tongue. The dark thins.

pilgrims_staff_tea.name: Pilgrim's Staff Tea
pilgrims_staff_tea.flavour: Bitter, hot, and it gets you to the next milestone.

mudlarks_hush.name: Mudlark's Hush
mudlarks_hush.flavour: Low and quiet. The tide forgets you were there.

hammermans_heft.name: Hammerman's Heft
hammermans_heft.flavour: Fed like an ox for one good swing. The anvil answers.

reliquary_wine.name: Reliquary Wine
reliquary_wine.flavour: Kept behind glass. It remembers every blow it turned.

marrow_broth.name: Marrow Broth
marrow_broth.flavour: Boiled all night. It gets into the joints and stays.

fogwalkers_draught.name: Fogwalker's Draught
fogwalkers_draught.flavour: Thick as a fen morning. Nobody looks twice.

high_table_cup.name: Cup of the High Table
high_table_cup.flavour: Poured for the ones who do not rise. A long, calm minute.

gravewardens_pour.name: Gravewarden's Pour
gravewardens_pour.flavour: Stands at the door all night so you do not have to.

forgemasters_quench.name: Forgemaster's Last Quench
forgemasters_quench.flavour: Fire asks. The answer is no.

long_march_tonic.name: Long March Tonic
long_march_tonic.flavour: The road is shorter than it was.

poisoned.does: disadvantage on attacks; venom keeps hurting

blinded.does: disadvantage on attacks; foes have advantage

resist_fire.does: half damage from fire; no burning

resist_frost.does: half damage from frost; no slowing

invisible.does: foes cannot pick them; advantage on the first blow, which ends it

warded.does: turns aside the first blow each round

regenerating.does: knits a little hurt back each second

scar_touched.does: its next spell is doubled - or misfires; the scar decides
